colors.encoding: Normalized RGBA, matching ImVec4 source values

body.usage: Menus, panel titles, controls, tables and evidence text
body.coverage: Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Arabic, general punctuation and CJK ideographs, subject to installed font glyph availability

optionalMerges.selection: First existing file in the installed Windows Fonts directory
Merge only when the installed file exists

hex.usage: Inspector Hex + ASCII read-only text field

typography.dpi: Font atlas sizes multiply the logical pixel sizes by initial window DPI. WM_DPICHANGED adjusts FontGlobalScale relative to that initial DPI.

spacing.unit: Logical pixels before initial DPI scaling
spacing.initialization: Window padding and item spacing are assigned before ScaleAllSizes(initial DPI). Other spacing uses the scaled ImGui defaults.
spacing.dpiChanges: WM_DPICHANGED scales current style sizes by new DPI divided by the previous style DPI.

radius.unit: Logical pixels before initial DPI scaling
radius.initialization: Explicit rounding values are assigned before ScaleAllSizes(initial DPI). Other radii use the scaled ImGui defaults.

layout.container: DockSpaceOverViewport on the main Win32 viewport
layout.menu: Main menu bar with session actions, recording, display pause, sampling, limits, state and frame rate

panels.name: Session & navigation
panels.contents: Process identity, coverage, retention and collector indicators, stack capture status, snapshots, allocation and memory-map navigation, status

panels.name: Allocations & memory map
panels.contents: Filtered allocation table or committed process-memory region table

panels.name: Inspector
panels.contents: Selected allocation identity and sampled content, or selected memory region and evidence

layout.tableBehavior: Allocation and region tables clip rows, scroll horizontally and vertically, and freeze their first column and header row.

capacityControls.budgetExhaustedMessage: SAMPLING STOPPED: byte budget exhausted. Increase the limit or choose rolling retention.

stackControls.label: Optional stack frames
stackControls.requirement: The target agent's allocation-free native unwinder probe must pass before capture is enabled.
stackControls.coverage: Active frame count out of eight, with an explicit unavailable message when native unwinder validation fails
stackControls.frameDisplay: Frame index, address and live symbol, or saved address for an offline session
stackControls.emptyState: Explains disabled capture or rejected and failed native capture

interactionValidation.desktopUI: Real ImGui queued keyboard and mouse input
interactionValidation.nativeDialogsAndDpi: Native common dialogs and synthetic WM_DPICHANGED messages on an unshown private desktop

components.name: Docked panel
components.description: Native ImGui window in a persistent four-panel dock layout.

components.name: Allocation and region tables
components.description: Resizable native ImGui tables with alternating rows, frozen headers and selectable records.

components.name: Inspector hex field
components.description: Read-only multiline Consolas field inside a horizontally scrollable child window, with selectable offsets, bytes and ASCII.

components.name: Navigation row
components.description: ImGui selectable for all allocations, the process memory map, heaps and snapshots.

components.name: Action button
components.description: ImGui button with teal default and hover fills, using the explicit frame radius.

narrative.overview: The native interface prioritizes dense tables and inspectable evidence. Its layout uses four dockable panels. Session controls stay in the main menu, and the Inspector remains visible beside the allocation table or memory map.
